standouts.head: A* setup: wave 2 of wave 3
standouts.text: Five clean waves up from Mar 19 to Jul 16 (+28%, wave 1). The pullback turned up from the 0.618–0.786 zone of that advance (−4.7% to −8.8%), on lighter volume, with the May 15 low and the 61.8% retracement of the Oct 14–Oct 23 rise in the same place. It is the second wave of a larger wave 3: five waves up from Jun 20, 2025 to Feb 9 and a pullback of 0.58 of them to the Mar 19 low came first, so the end of this wave 2 starts wave 3 of 3, the strongest move a chart makes. The count is wrong under the start of wave 1 (−14%). A daily close above the wave-1 high (+10%) says wave 3 is under way.
standouts.learn: After five waves up, the pullback that usually ends between the 0.618 and 0.786 retracement of the advance. The zone is where to watch; a daily close up inside it is the buy. Under the start of wave 1 the count is wrong.

standouts.learn: After a breakout, price often comes back to the line it broke; old resistance becomes new support.
